'''Tol Skorr's second starship''' was a heavily-armed [[KR-TB "Doomtreader"]]. [[Tol Skorr]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used it to chase [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to the ''[[Titavian IV]]''.<ref name="Republic">[[Republic 70|''Republic'' 70]]</ref>
